violation_type.title: Children Handwashing After Feeding or Touching Animals (26 TAC §746.3417(6))
violation_type.short_title: Children Handwashing After Feeding or Touching Animals
violation_type.typical_finding: The children were finishing up their lunch when I got to the location. As they finished up, they were directed to get their napmats and lay down for nap.

finding_variants.text: The children were finishing up their lunch when I got to the location. As they finished up, they were directed to get their napmats and lay down for nap.
A child was seen touching a dog while she was eating and continued eating without a caregiver telling her to wash her hands.
